title: N66001-26-Q-6127 - Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source to ICE Enterprises, Inc.
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.SPAWAR.SPAWAR PACIFIC.NIWC PACIFIC
detail_text: N66001-26-Q-6127 - Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source to ICE Enterprises, Inc.The Department of the Navy, Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific (NIWC Pacific) hereby publicizes its intention to solicit, negotiate, and award a Commercial, Firm-Fixed-Price purchase order on a noncompetitive basis with ICE Enterprises. The requirement is for the purchase of the following:Item 0001:DSP PlatformManufacturer: ICE EnterprisesP/N: ICE-TRAY-SFF-M3107QTY: 1The above items include ICE?s commercially available DSP Platform. ICE is the only capable source who can provide the required products.A determination by the government not to compete based upon responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the government. However, all responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. The applicable NAICS Code is 334111 and the business size standard is 1,250 employees. The point of contact for this announcement is Andrew Cornwell at andrew.d.cornwell.civ@us.navy.mil.Be advised that the aforementioned information is anticipatory in nature and is not binding. A copy of the Request for Quote will be made available upon request. Any comments, questions or concerns regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to Andrew Cornwell at andrew.d.cornwell.civ@us.navy.mil by 24 April 2026 at 0800 PST. Questions by phone or fax will not be considered.
